'''Du'un''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Electrician/Legends|electrician]] and a member of [[Junker Jott's crew]] who lived on the [[Asteroid base|asteroid station]] [[Mek-Sha]] during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Du'un was killed in [[Drifter's Quarter]] by agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR:JJC" /> in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR_updates" />
